card.name: Inside surnames and eponym names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a proper name split into several parts, such as the 'old' in Niepold, 'law' in Bronislaw, 'ung' in Hirschsprung, or 'illing' in Schilling. It also appears in the drug name nisoldipine.

modes.label: Person surnames
modes.description: Closing piece of a person's name, often a Polish or German surname.

modes.label: Eponym disease or test names
modes.description: Last piece of a name-based medical term like Hirschsprung disease or Schilling's test.

modes.label: Drug name piece
modes.description: Middle piece of the drug name nisoldipine.

card.plain: It fires partway through rare names of people or name-based medical terms that get broken into pieces.
